name: Spanish
description: Spontaneous conversational fluency, rapid subjunctive and tense conjugation under time pressure, real-time vocabulary retrieval without English crutches, and situational high-stakes immersion.

dimensions.name: Spontaneous Fluency & Cadence
dimensions.description: Real-time spoken Spanish delivery, rapid retrieval under time pressure, zero English filler words (e.g., 'like', 'um', 'este', 'o sea').

rubricCriteria.90-100: Immediate fluid delivery at 120-150 WPM in authentic Spanish; zero English intrusions; natural connectives (sin embargo, por lo tanto).
rubricCriteria.70-89: Consistent conversational flow with minor hesitation; 1-2 minor pauses; communicative intent preserved.
rubricCriteria.50-69: Frequent mid-sentence stalls (>3s); persistent code-switching or English crutches; broken cadence.
rubricCriteria.0-49: Inability to formulate coherent sentences in Spanish; freezes or relies almost entirely on English.

dimensions.name: Grammatical & Tense Conjugation Precision
dimensions.description: Subjunctive vs. Indicative, Preterite vs. Imperfect, Por vs. Para, Ser vs. Estar, and direct/indirect object pronoun placement under cognitive load.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Flawless mood and tense selection (correct subjunctive in doubt/hypotheticals, accurate preterite/imperfect distinctions, accurate clitic pronoun placement).
rubricCriteria.70-89: Generally correct syntax and verb stems; 1-2 minor tense slips that do not distort meaning.
rubricCriteria.50-69: Frequent grammatical breakdowns (confusing ser/estar, incorrect past tense aspect, missing required subjunctive).
rubricCriteria.0-49: Pervasive structural errors; wrong verb conjugations make meaning unintelligible.

dimensions.name: Contextual Vocabulary & Idiomatic Precision
dimensions.description: Domain-specific lexical retrieval, appropriate idiomatic expressions, avoiding false cognates (falsos amigos) under conversational pressure.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Rich, nuanced vocabulary tailored to context; authentic idioms; zero false cognates (e.g. éxito vs salida, actual vs corriente).
rubricCriteria.70-89: Accurate functional vocabulary; minor circumlocution or slightly stiff phrasing.
rubricCriteria.50-69: Imprecise vocabulary; literal English calques; awkward word choices.
rubricCriteria.0-49: Extremely limited vocabulary; invents false Spanish words based on English words.

dimensions.name: Situational Immersion & Pressure Negotiation
dimensions.description: Navigating high-stakes real-world pressure scenarios (emergency triage, contract dispute, landlord conflict, airport crisis) entirely in Spanish.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Resolves complex, adversarial situational objectives assertively and diplomatically in full Spanish.
rubricCriteria.70-89: Addresses situational demands well with minor hesitation in negotiation posture.
rubricCriteria.50-69: Struggles to command the situation; yields authority due to linguistic friction.
rubricCriteria.0-49: Fails the situational challenge; breaks character or reverts to English.
